I’ve spent tens of thousands over time; aside from Lectulu, all my units are +12. I spent money simply to easily max out the rewards, but now the stats for the 450-point tier are absurdly high, and hitting 500 points is an absolute grind-fest that drives you mad.
I can't see the point of spending money anymore—am I paying just to buff the enemy's stats? I vaguely recall "School Cat" promising that "Limit Break" (Super-limit) and "Final Law" wouldn't be mandatory requirements for clearing content.
So, let me ask: can you even touch the 450 tier without +12 gear? Can you survive the 500 tier without it? Have you left any room for low-investment players to survive? Is this something that can be beaten through pure player skill? Do you realize how many accounts' 425-point runs were actually done by the same hired pilot? You rushed to ramp up the difficulty, removing lower-difficulty options just to pressure newcomers and low-investment players. Accounts that used to grind out 400 points now struggle to even hit 350—is this what you call "benefiting newcomers"? Then you churn out banner after banner, forcing us to pull for cards just to have a chance at winning. You’ve become completely obsessed with money.
Have you seen how many newcomers and low-investment players have sold their accounts and quit since the new "Fusion Disaster" mode launched? Don't talk to me about using "Lingzhi" (stamina refills); are there really players willing to constantly burn resources—sacrificing the game's positive feedback loop and sense of achievement—just to clear a stage? After playing for so long, this is the moment that finally made me question myself and the point of spending money. School Cat, you win. Do whatever you want; I guess we players just deserve to suffer through it.
If the player base thinks you’re doing a great job and the new mode is fantastic, then never mind what I said; I’ll just quietly quit the game. I surrender. I’m sorry.
